d:
In early 2025, during the release week of their Grammy-nominated album Chapter III: We Return to Light, Alam Khan joined Anoushka Shankar and her band — Sarathy Korwar, Arun Ghosh and Tom Farmer — for a luminous live performance at Bing Concert Hall. Written by Anoushka in collaboration with Alam and Sarathy, these pieces felt especially powerful to share onstage together.
Among the highlights is Chapter III closer, ‘We Return to Love.’
Written by Anoushka Shankar, Alam Khan, Sarathy Korwar
Sitar: Anoushka Shankar
Sarod: Alam Khan
Drums: Sarathy Korwar
Double Bass: Tom Farmer
